recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-12502 unless a future Security work group decision reintroduces broader related-agent relationship modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-12502 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for the Security work group. It requested removal of Provenance.agent.relatedAgentType because the element no longer made semantic sense after relatedAgent was simplified; the final resolution said onBehalfOf covered the intended in-scope relationship and other relationships were outside the 80% need.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by commit 84f8086d21facb3551bfb28481156250510ae48b, whose message lists Provenance GF#12502. In the then-authoritative provenance spreadsheet source, that commit changed Provenance.agent.relatedAgentType to !Provenance.agent.relatedAgentType and removed relatedAgentType use from a Provenance example.
additional_context: Provenance is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The current source/provenance/structuredefinition-Provenance.xml defines Provenance.agent with type, role, who, and onBehalfOf, then proceeds to Provenance.entity; current non-history source contains no relatedAgentType references. Remaining relatedAgentType occurrences are in tools/history release snapshots, which preserve old published releases and are not current-build source. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no substantive later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no current source edit is needed: the authoritative current Provenance source already omits Provenance.agent.relatedAgentType while retaining onBehalfOf.
